messages.author: c9d3d5ccfb223adb
messages.subject: Warning messages
parts:
Hi everyone, this is my first experiment with the GGIR package (my study focuses on sleep rather than activity), and when I convert some of the files it does it successfully, but says there are warnings (same thing but 12 times):

In breaks_i[bi] <- fullQqq[grep(breaks[bi], ts$time[fullQqq])] :

  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

Has anyone else had this come up? I've tried to google what it means and no-one seems to have posted it on the group here already. I just wanted to check it isn't some sort of fatal prproblem!

Thank you so much,

Jen
